title: 第九章双目异变第十章震惊的马得水
slug: 扫地八十年从宗门杂役飞升成仙
lines: 在屋里愣了好半天，叶凡手里攥着疾风飘叶。
拳法有了，身法也有了。
之前揍废阁狗腿子，纯靠肉身硬压，简单粗暴，爽是爽，可碰上真正懂行的外门弟子，绝壁要吃亏。
天剑宗的外门弟子，哪怕再普通，也不可能个个都跟这俩货一样，只会抡拳头吓唬人。
会身法的，会剑术的，会符箓的。
随便来个懂门道的，都能让他头疼。
把两本合成出来的功法揣进怀里，叶凡推门而出。
废丹洞附近没人。
毒瘴还在翻滚，但对他已经没了威胁。
走到木屋外一块空地上，叶凡翻开优化后的碎石拳，又仔细看了一遍。
以前看这门拳法，只觉得粗糙。
现在再看，那些批注却处处落在发力要害上。
脚下起步，腰胯跟上，肩臂发力。
叶凡照着上面的拆解，慢慢摆开架势。
第一拳。
砰！
拳风炸开。
远处一块碎石被打的滚出去半丈。
叶凡皱了皱眉。力散了。
他收拳，再来。
第二拳，落点准了些，但肩膀提前用力，拳势僵硬。
第三拳，脚下踩偏，差点把自己带歪。
换成八十年前的叶凡，估计练半个月都摸不到门。
但现在不同。
昨夜九龙搬血一转，烧掉的可不只是丹毒。
这具身体的反应，比以前快了太多。
脑子里刚想到问题，身体就能跟着调整。
半个时辰后。
叶凡站在原地，缓缓吐了口气。
右脚往地上一踏。
腰背发力。
拳头瞬间打出。
砰！
前方三步外，地面扬起灰尘。
叶凡收拳，盯着自己的拳头看了片刻。入门了。
没有什么天花乱坠的动静。
可这一拳和刚才完全不一样。
力量顺着全身拧成一股，出拳瞬间没有半点浪费。
他又连续打了十几拳。
每一拳都比前一拳顺。
到后面，甚至不用再去想书上的批注，身体自己就能找到最舒服、最狠的发力方式。
content_en:
Ye Fan was stunned in the room for a long time, holding the windy leaf in his hand.
The boxing skills are there, and the body skills are also there.
In the past, beating up the loser of Fei Ge was purely based on hard physical pressure. It was simple and rough, and it was great. But when you meet the outer disciples who really know what they are doing, you will definitely suffer a loss.
No matter how ordinary the outer disciples of Tianjian Sect are, it is impossible for all of them to be like these two guys and only know how to scare people with their fists.
Those who know body skills, those who know swordsmanship, and those who know talismans.
Anyone who knows his stuff can give him a headache.
Putting the two combined exercises into his arms, Ye Fan pushed the door open and walked out.
There is no one near the Feidan Cave.
The poisonous miasma was still churning, but it no longer threatened him.
Walking to an open space outside the wooden house, Ye Fan opened the optimized gravel fist and looked at it carefully again.
When I looked at this boxing technique before, I thought it was rough.
Looking back now, those comments are always on the key points.
Start with your feet, keep up with your waist and hips, and use force on your shoulders and arms.
Ye Fan followed the disassembly above and slowly got into position.
The first punch.
Bang!
The fist wind exploded.
A piece of gravel in the distance was rolled half a foot away.
Ye Fan frowned. The strength is gone.
He closed his fist and came again.
The second punch landed more accurately, but the shoulder was forced earlier and the punch was stiff.
For the third punch, he stepped on the wrong foot and almost knocked himself sideways.
If it were Ye Fan from 80 years ago, he probably wouldn't be able to touch the door even if he practiced for half a month.
But it's different now.
Last night there was a bloodbath in Kowloon, and it wasn't just the erysipelas that was burned away.
This body's reaction is much faster than before.
As soon as the problem comes to mind, the body can adjust accordingly.
Half an hour later.
Ye Fan stood there and breathed out slowly.
Step your right foot onto the ground.
Use force in your lower back.
The fist was punched instantly.
Bang!
Three steps ahead, dust was rising from the ground.
Ye Fan closed his fist and stared at his fist for a moment. Getting started.
There's no fanfare.
But this punch was completely different from before.
The strength was twisted along the whole body, and there was no waste in the moment of punching.
He punched a dozen more times in succession.
Each punch was smoother than the previous one.
Later, you don’t even need to think about the comments in the book, your body will be able to find the most comfortable and most powerful way to exert force.
